description: This file implements the server-side code for an online multiple-choice question (MCQ) exam page. It handles loading questions from the database, displaying options, managing session data, timing the exam, and submitting answers to the database.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQ exam ASPX page, managing question loading, user interactions, timing, and answer submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes the exam page by loading questions from the database based on the selected course stored in session. Sets up the timer if applicable.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the User Profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the user's score based on selected answers, saves the result into the database, and navigates to the results page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Handles the exam timer, updating the display and submitting the exam if time expires.
